origin.description: Parse R source into expressions, keeping comment and blank lines that sit outside an expression.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Source as text, a list of lines, a callable, or a text stream.

arguments.name: allow_error
arguments.text: When true, a parse error is returned instead of raised.

origin.details: A complete input that shares a line, including several expressions joined by semicolons, is one row. A comment inside a function body stays inside that function. A line that ends with a newline does not add an extra blank row.
origin.value: The source lines and the expressions they contain.
origin.example:
source <- c("# a comment", "x", "x;y", "x;y;z")
parsed <- parse_all(source)
print(lengths(parsed$expr))
print(parsed$src)
